subject: Close path realignment and risk tracker for Q4 MAP

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@acme-corp.com>

Cc: Michael Chu <michael.chu@acme-corp.com>, contracts@acme-corp.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft — proposed timeline shift (need to discuss)

Neha —

Quick note after internal exec alignment this morning: Acme needs to push the integration milestone (API sandbox validation) by two weeks due to an internal security gating change. That will ripple our close from 2026-11-30 to ~2026-12-14 unless we change scope or arrange a staggered go-live.

I attached a short note with the suggested new MAP and the items the security team flagged.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can (a) provide a temporary limited sandbox access next week, and (b) move the PoC evaluation slots earlier to mitigate the slip? If not, we should get ahead of contract/renewal approvals (contracts@acme-corp.com) and map expectations to the Q4 executive review.

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acme Corp

[Attachment: MAP_Acme_v2.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft — proposed timeline shift (need to discuss)

Olivia — thanks for the heads up and for the MAP doc. I reviewed the security notes at a glance. We can offer two mitigations:

1) Provision a limited sandbox cluster (read-only logs, masked samples) by 2026-11-24; ops will lock configs to the eval cohort.
2) Re-sequence the eval plan so functional tests run this week and performance/latency tests the week of 11/30 — that shortens the customer-facing dependency window.

I'll loop in Marcus to confirm capacity and Rishi to update the close-risk tracker. If Acme is comfortable with the staggered acceptance criteria, we can aim to keep the contract signature by 2026-12-07.

Action items for Redwood: make sandbox available (Marcus), update MAP with acceptance gates (Neha/Rishi).

Neha Kapoor

Team —

I updated the tracker with three new risk rows reflecting Acme's security gating:
1) Integration milestone delayed by 14 days — likelihood: medium, impact: high. Contingency: staggered acceptance + limited sandbox.
2) Contract approval queue — legal review may add 5 business days. Contingency: pre-approved T&C appendix with standard SLAs.
3) Eval capacity mismatch — perf slots limited. Contingency: Redwood provides 2 dedicated perf windows and allows a short running of a Canary model at reduced throughput.

Proposed re-baseline dates:
- API sandbox ready: 2026-11-24
- Functional eval complete: 2026-11-26
- Performance eval slots: 2026-11-30 to 2026-12-02
- Target signature date (revised): 2026-12-07

I attached the CSV export. Please review and confirm.

Rishi Malhotra
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
